cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Stay for the Result
cards.instruction: Keep them present until the contest, bargain, or consequence reaches an undeniable outcome.

mechanism: Copy scale-zeroing at the wrong stage, then keep the rival present to secure an uncontestable competition result.
confusable: Not just a boastful weigh-in: B2 must show the mistaken copied zero and A3 preserve confidence while attempting to fix it.
comparison: Measurement witnessing differs from resolving a dinner payment.
seedUse: Retains pumpkin contest and insisting on a witnessed number; changes size boasting to a tare error.
